svg.title: C.R.A.T.E.R. — a rover records an incident, asks its local AI after capture, and Mission Control reads the cited answer
svg.desc: Motion-free variant of the C.R.A.T.E.R. hero, generated from crater-readme-hero.svg. A dark mission-control panel in three parts. Left: a rover drives across lunar terrain while a sensor bar sweeps the scene and three tracked rocks are marked, ending in capture complete, thirty of thirty frames. Centre: the ROBOT INCIDENT DIALOGUE panel holds a persisted incident with a UUID, the kind telemetry_stale, the trigger capture_stale, provenance historical_replay, certifiedMeasurement false and a stored validated v1 snapshot, followed by one server-chosen text question asking for the evidence limitations of delayed observations, and a job state that moves from waiting for producer capture end, to waiting for local AI, to analyzing, to analysis complete. Right: Mission Control shows the same hazards on a LOCAL_ENU_V1 map above a cited local AI reply about delay-tolerant relays, labelled UNVERIFIED GENERATED EXPLANATION with source S1, and a note that operator review is separate and no rover command is generated. Along the bottom a six-stage rail runs from detect, through a simulated radio blackout where frames queue and are resent, to the recorded incident, to the robot question, across a capture-ends gate that admits the local model only once capture has finished, to the post-capture analysis and the displayed answer.
svg.text: A blackout becomes a recorded incident. The rover asks its local AI after capture. Mission Control reads the cited answer.

g.text: ROVER DETECTS · THREE PERSISTENT ROCK TRACKS ON A RECORDED ONNX REPLAY
SIMULATED RADIO BLACKOUT · ACCEPTED FRAMES QUEUE, THEN RETRANSMIT
INCIDENT RECORDED · UUID, PROVENANCE AND A VALIDATED v1 SNAPSHOT PERSIST
ROBOT ASKS ITS LOCAL AI · ONE SERVER-CHOSEN TEXT QUESTION, NEVER VOICE
ONLY AFTER CAPTURE ENDS · LOCAL QWEN3 READS THREE CITED PASSAGES
MISSION CONTROL DISPLAYS A CITED, UNVERIFIED EXPLANATION FOR REVIEW

svg.text: QUICK DEMO REMAINS TWO COMMANDS AND MODEL-FREE · RADIO LOSS AND BLACKOUT ARE SIMULATED · GENERATION RUNS AFTER CAPTURE, NEVER DURING LIVE PERCEPTION
